paper_name: Scheduling Suspendable, Pipelined Tasks with Non-Preemptive Sections in Soft Real-Time Multiprocessor Systems
paper_description: Transforms periodic task systems with suspensions, pipelines, and non-preemptive sections into equivalent suspension-only systems preserving max response times, enabling bounded tardiness analysis under GEDF.
